title: Lex-plus-powers Betti bounds for Artinian quotients over C
exact_target: Let $S=C[x_{1},\dots ,x_{n}]$, $n\geq 1$, and let I contain a homogeneous regular sequence of degrees $2\leq a_{1}\leq \cdots \leq a_{n}$. Is there a $lex-plus-(x_{1}^{a_{1}},\dots ,x_{n}^{a_{n}})$ ideal L with the same Hilbert function as I and $\beta ^S_{i,j}(S/I)\leq \beta ^S_{i,j}(S/L)$ for every i,j?
